title: Retrieve Dead-End Pick Tray
description: Carry a 12 kg pick tray from the end of a 7 m rack spur to its entrance using three modules docked in a line. Drive forward into the 0.34 m passage and reverse out along the same path because there is no turning space; allow about 40 seconds of travel each way.
payload_desc: Tray of boxed machine fasteners
motion_rationale: Forward entry and loaded reverse withdrawal peak at 0.19 m/s to cover each 7 m leg in roughly 40 seconds with gentle starts and stops.

title: Shuttle Small Palletized Parts
description: Move a 26 kg miniature pallet of fittings from the cross-dock receiving table to a dispatch stand on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body. Cover the 12 m main lane in about 50 seconds, turn clockwise through 90 degrees in the marked junction, then go diagonally front-left across a 2 m staging gap and slide right 0.3 m into the stand.
payload_desc: Miniature pallet of bagged pipe fittings
motion_rationale: The 12 m timed run needs 0.26 m/s surge, the clear staging crossing permits 0.17 m/s diagonal travel, the stand requires 0.045 m/s lateral alignment, and the loaded six-module body turns at 28 deg/s.

title: Deliver Tote Between Shelf Guards
description: Carry a 7 kg tote along a 4 m shelf lane using a two-module body aligned lengthwise with the lane. At the station, slide left 0.42 m through a 0.30 m opening between guards while keeping the tote square, then slide right to withdraw after unloading; allow about 12 seconds for each lateral move.
payload_desc: Narrow tote of packaged electrical connectors
motion_rationale: The unobstructed 4 m approach permits 0.16 m/s surge, while the guarded 0.42 m insertion and withdrawal require 0.04 m/s sway to fit their roughly 12-second windows.

title: Scan Long Rack Faces
description: Carry a 2 kg RFID reader along a 24 m rack face on a six-module body, completing the moving scan in about 95 seconds. At the wide end bay, turn counter-clockwise through 180 degrees and scan the opposite face on the return run.
payload_desc: Deck-mounted RFID reader and compact antenna mast
motion_rationale: Each 24 m scanning pass needs near-full 0.265 m/s surge to finish in about 95 seconds, and the clear end bay permits a 34 deg/s turn for the larger body.

title: Unload Dense Trailer Parts Crate
description: Carry an 18 kg crate of brake components from a parked trailer's rear staging position to the receiving bench using a four-module square body. The trailer floor and dock are flush with a secured level bridge; drive forward over the 6 m route, slide left 0.5 m at the bench, and reverse clear after unloading.
payload_desc: Compact strapped crate of brake components
motion_rationale: The dense load and bridge crossing limit surge to 0.145 m/s for a roughly 45-second approach, while the half-metre bench offset uses 0.055 m/s sway.

title: Rush Samples Through Cold Storage
description: Move a 3 kg insulated sample box down a dry 20 m cold-storage aisle to the pass-through hatch within 85 seconds of departure. Keep the two-module body pointed down the aisle and slide right 0.25 m at the hatch for handoff.
payload_desc: Insulated box of chilled quality-control samples
motion_rationale: The 20 m delivery deadline requires 0.26 m/s surge with time for braking, and the hatch's short alignment stroke uses 0.035 m/s sway.

title: Feed Mezzanine Conveyor Fixture
description: Carry a 19 kg loaded assembly fixture from the mezzanine buffer table to a conveyor loading nest on the same level. Drive forward 5 m, turn counter-clockwise through 90 degrees in the marked square, and slide left 0.6 m into the nest without crossing the guarded floor edge.
payload_desc: Loaded steel assembly fixture
motion_rationale: The near-capacity fixture needs 0.135 m/s surge over the 5 m approach, a restrained 16 deg/s quarter-turn, and 0.045 m/s sway for controlled conveyor insertion.

title: Sort Returned Motor Assemblies
description: Move a 9 kg returned motor in a fitted cradle from the returns scale to the electrical-test queue. Reverse 1.2 m out of the scale pocket, turn clockwise through 90 degrees in a clear square, and travel diagonally front-right for 3 m to the queue marker.
payload_desc: Returned motor assembly in a fitted cradle
motion_rationale: The loaded scale withdrawal uses 0.085 m/s reverse surge, the secured motor allows an 18 deg/s turn, and the 3 m diagonal transfer uses 0.125 m/s to reach the queue in about 26 seconds.

title: Align Tray With Mobile Rack
description: Carry a 6 kg parts tray 3 m into an opened mobile-rack aisle using three modules in a line. With the racks locked, slide left 0.18 m toward the transfer fingers and make a clockwise heading correction of at most 3 degrees; the final lateral approach must remain slow enough for millimetre-scale camera corrections.
payload_desc: Parts tray with locating slots
motion_rationale: The short rack entry uses 0.095 m/s surge, while the locating fingers require 0.014 m/s lateral approach and a 1.8 deg/s heading correction.

title: Place Pharmacy Order Cassette
description: Carry a 1.4 kg sealed order cassette 2 m forward between the pharmacy workcells on one module. Slide right 0.32 m through a 0.27 m guard opening to the verification shelf, then slide left clear after the cassette is lifted; keep the cassette facing the scanner throughout.
payload_desc: Sealed narrow medication-order cassette
motion_rationale: The 2 m workcell approach uses 0.115 m/s surge, and the narrow guarded shelf requires 0.028 m/s sway for roughly 13-second insertion and withdrawal strokes.

title: Search Cleared Corridor Spur
description: Carry a 1.8 kg thermal camera and microphone along an 18 m cleared strip inside a partially collapsed building. Reach the search position in about 75 seconds, slide left 0.7 m around a fallen cabinet, and reverse 2 m away from the unstable doorway after the observation stop.
payload_desc: Thermal camera and directional microphone
motion_rationale: The 18 m response run requires 0.26 m/s peak surge, also available for the clear reverse withdrawal, while the cabinet bypass uses 0.075 m/s sway.

title: Deliver Office Search Beacon
description: Carry a 2.2 kg radio beacon and thermal imager across a smoke-filled office floor on three modules in a line. Follow a verified 14 m clear corridor in about 60 seconds, turn clockwise through 90 degrees at the lobby, and go diagonally front-left 2.5 m between desk islands to the beacon location.
payload_desc: Radio beacon and thermal imager
motion_rationale: The response corridor needs 0.25 m/s surge, the clear lobby allows a 32 deg/s turn, and the desk-island gap reduces diagonal speed to 0.145 m/s.

title: Survey Garage Debris Boundary
description: Carry a 1 kg camera and air sensor along a swept 16 m lane beside a parking-garage debris field, reaching the far inspection mark in about 65 seconds. At two marked gaps, slide right and then left by 0.5 m to look past parked vehicles without entering the rubble.
payload_desc: Compact camera and air-quality sensor
motion_rationale: The 16 m timed transit requires 0.265 m/s surge, while the half-metre viewing offsets use 0.065 m/s sway near vehicle edges.

title: Probe Flooded Basement Dead Ends
description: Carry a 3 kg water-quality probe and camera into two 4 m dead-end basement service passages. With the four-module body remaining square to each passage, drive forward through shallow standing water and reverse out, then slide right 1 m across the connecting corridor to the second entrance.
payload_desc: Water-quality probe and low-mounted inspection camera
motion_rationale: Wet-floor traction limits the four forward and reverse 4 m legs to 0.095 m/s, and the connecting lateral transfer uses 0.055 m/s to avoid abrupt wheel slip.

title: Inspect Tunnel Crosspassage Doors
description: Carry a 2.5 kg thermal camera through a flat utility tunnel after a quake, stopping at four crosspassage doors spaced 3 m apart. At each door, turn in place 90 degrees toward the opening and turn back after inspection, alternating clockwise and counter-clockwise turns as the doors change sides.
payload_desc: Thermal camera with fixed forward-facing lens
motion_rationale: The short 3 m station transfers use 0.175 m/s surge, while eight repeated quarter-turns use 44 deg/s to keep reorientation near three seconds per turn including settling.

title: Distribute Corridor Evacuation Supplies
description: Carry a 7 kg tray of evacuation masks and radios between three staffed hospital corridor stations, each 4 m apart. Travel forward between stations and turn in place toward alternating left and right handoff bays, returning to the corridor heading after each delivery; use the widened bays for all turns.
payload_desc: Secured tray of evacuation masks and handheld radios
motion_rationale: The occupied corridor calls for 0.155 m/s surge between stations, and repeated handoff reorientations use 24 deg/s for controlled turns beside staff.

title: Move Fragile Landing Sample
description: Carry a 1.1 kg glass air-sampling cartridge in a padded holder from the stairwell landing's sampling stand to the responder's collection tray 1.4 m away. Stay entirely on the flat landing, slide left 0.22 m around the stand foot, and drive forward without turning or approaching the stair opening.
payload_desc: Glass air-sampling cartridge in a padded holder
motion_rationale: The fragile cartridge limits the 1.4 m forward transfer to 0.052 m/s and the stand-foot clearance move to 0.022 m/s sway, with additional time for gentle acceleration.

title: Map Post-Fire Warehouse Air
description: Carry a 2 kg gas logger down a 32 m cleared warehouse aisle to a remote sampling mark. Drive straight forward in about 130 seconds, sample for 25 seconds, and reverse the full aisle because the far end remains cordoned off.
payload_desc: Gas logger with short sampling inlet
motion_rationale: Both 32 m straight legs need 0.26 m/s peak surge to fit approximately 130 seconds per leg while retaining braking distance before the cordon.

title: Carry Carriage Medical Vials
description: Carry a 2.8 kg padded case of glass medical vials from the responder at one vestibule to a treatment team 9 m down a stationary train carriage. Use two modules in a line, drive forward between the seat rows, and slide right 0.28 m at the cleared wheelchair bay for handoff without turning the case.
payload_desc: Padded case of glass medical vials
motion_rationale: The long narrow aisle and glass load limit surge to 0.085 m/s for roughly 110 seconds of travel, while the wheelchair-bay handoff uses 0.026 m/s sway.

title: Dock Refuge Air Monitor
description: Carry a 3.2 kg atmosphere monitor across the flat floor of a mine refuge chamber to its charging and data dock. Keep the connector face parallel to the wall while moving diagonally front-right 2.1 m between fixed benches, then slide right the final 0.12 m into the guide rails.
payload_desc: Atmosphere monitor in a docking cradle
motion_rationale: The 2.1 m bench gap uses 0.115 m/s diagonal travel without changing connector heading, followed by 0.016 m/s sway for the final 0.12 m rail engagement.

title: Measure Cold-Aisle Rack Intake
description: Carry a 4 kg temperature-sensor array down a 10 m data-centre cold aisle on a four-module square body. At each of five rack positions, slide left 0.16 m toward the intake grille and right back to the travel line without yawing; keep at least 0.05 m between the sensor frame and cabinet faces.
payload_desc: Compact rack-intake temperature and airflow array
motion_rationale: The 10 m stop-and-sample route uses 0.145 m/s surge, while ten close-clearance lateral strokes require 0.024 m/s sway to preserve the cabinet standoff.

title: Inspect Inverter Cabinet Seam
description: Carry a 1.6 kg thermal camera along a 3.6 m indoor inverter cabinet row using two modules in a line. From the end bay, slide left 0.38 m into the 0.32 m service passage, drive forward while recording cabinet seams, and reverse back out without turning.
payload_desc: Thermal camera on a short rigid mount
motion_rationale: Thermal recording and narrow clearance limit forward and reverse surge to 0.105 m/s, while the 0.38 m entrance offset requires 0.032 m/s sway.

title: Inspect Underwing Service Recess
description: Carry a 3 kg upward-facing inspection camera beneath a parked aircraft wing on three modules docked in a line. Drive 6 m forward into a service recess between maintenance stands, reverse the same distance because the recess has no turning room, and slide right 0.8 m only after reaching the clear hangar floor.
payload_desc: Upward-facing camera and low-profile lighting bar
motion_rationale: The underwing inspection and matching reverse withdrawal use 0.125 m/s surge for roughly 50 seconds each, and the clear-floor relocation permits 0.075 m/s sway.

title: Survey Engine Room Gauge Faces
description: Carry a 6 kg acoustic and camera package along an 8 m machinery route on a six-module 0.6 by 0.4 m body while the ship is berthed. Stop in four marked clear squares and turn in place toward alternating port and starboard gauge panels, returning to the route heading after each reading.
payload_desc: Directional acoustic sensor and gauge-reading camera
motion_rationale: The machinery route uses 0.135 m/s surge between stops, while eight gauge-facing quarter-turns use 26 deg/s to control the larger body's swept footprint.

title: Map Turbine Hall Bearing Stations
description: Carry an 8 kg thermal and acoustic instrument package along a 15 m reserved turbine-hall lane on a six-module body, reaching the first bearing station in about 65 seconds. Turn counter-clockwise through 90 degrees in the clear inspection square, go diagonally front-left 2.4 m around a marked pedestal exclusion zone, slide right 0.2 m for the reading, and reverse 1 m before turning clockwise back toward the lane.
payload_desc: Thermal camera and directional acoustic instrument package
motion_rationale: The 15 m timed lane run needs 0.25 m/s peak surge with a slow reverse withdrawal, the pedestal bypass uses 0.155 m/s diagonal travel, precise sensor placement uses 0.025 m/s sway, and the six-module body reorients at 29 deg/s.
